messages.author: 530bea09565f624b
messages.subject: wind vectors in ggmap
parts:
Hi,

Is it possible to plot wind vectors (wind speed and wind direction) in ggmap?

I have a series of met stations and want to display wind vectors at the lat/long station locations.

Thanks,

 

Jean-Paul Huys

Air Quality Specialist | ph 702.455.1684

hu...@ClarkCountyNV.gov

Clark County Dept of Air Quality

4701 W Russell Rd, Suite 200, Las Vegas, NV 89118

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: wind vectors in ggmap
parts:
On Mon, Jan 6, 2014 at 9:59 AM, Ben Bond-Lamberty <bpb...@gmail.com> wrote:
> ...I'm sorry, just noticed you were asking about ggmap, not ggplot. B

I think the original advice was OK, absent a reproducible example. One
can use ggplot2 code in conjunction with ggmap, as is indicated by the
paper by David Kahle and Hadley Wickham in the R Journal:
http://journal.r-project.org/archive/2013-1/kahle-wickham.pdf (see the
section 'Analysis - ggmap in action' for an illustration).

Dennis
